1 14.08.2024 Heard Mr. P.J. Barman, learned counsel for the appellant.

This appeal under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 is directed against the judgment and award dated 25.01.2024, passed by the learned Member, MACT No.1, Kamrup(M), Guwahati, in MAC Case No.1236/2016.

It is to be noted here that vide impugned judgment and award dated 25.01.2024, the learned Member, MACT No.1, Kamrup(M), Guwahati, has directed the appellant to pay a sum of Rs.5,75,690/- being the compensation with 6.5% interest per annum from the date of filing the claim petition till payment.
Perused the memo of appeal and the grounds mentioned therein and also perused the impugned judgment and award dated 25.01.2024.
This appeal is admitted for hearing, subject to depositing 50% of the awarded amount before the Registry of this Court within a period of 2(two) weeks from today.
Issue notice to the respondents, returnable within 4(four) weeks.
Step be taken by registered post with A/D and also by usual process within a week from today.
Registry shall call for the record from the learned Trial Court.

Sd/- Robin Phukan JUDGE Comparing Assistant The National Insurance Company Ltd vs Sanjay Kalita And 2 Ors E on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/76289324/
